hook: Four fishermen and a dog in a life raft, 190 miles off Alaska.
narration: Four fishermen and their dog were in this life raft, a hundred and ninety miles off Alaska.
Their boat, the Ocean Viking, was taking on water faster than they could keep up, so they abandoned ship.
A Jayhawk crew from Air Station Kodiak flew out and put a swimmer in the water beside them.
In water this cold, people can lose the use of their hands in about ten minutes, [short pause] so every lift counts.
outcome: The Kodiak crew hoisted all four fishermen and their dog out of the raft.
title: Life raft 190 miles off Alaska
description:
A Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk crew from Air Station Kodiak rescued four fishermen and a dog from a life raft 190 miles southwest of Kodiak, Alaska, on June 26, 2013, after their fishing vessel Ocean Viking took on water.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Kodiak, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/294890/coast-guard-rescues-4-fishermen-dog-ocean-viking-southwest-kodiak-alaska
